subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The city had to balance business, memory, and local life.”?
options: A place can be renewed without being erased, but only if people protect its story.
The old swing reminded everyone that a place can change without losing its story.
Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.
Working with nature can sometimes protect people better than forcing nature into straight lines.
